office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Rick Leo, elected to the Evergreen Division in 2022, is the only candidate. Elected by Evergreen District voters only.

candidates.summary: Evergreen Division District Court judge since 2023 and former court commissioner, prosecutor and defense attorney, running unopposed.
highlights: Evergreen District Court judge since 2023; District Court commissioner 2015-2023 [S1]
Former deputy prosecutor, public defender and private defense attorney [S1]
Past president of the District and Municipal Court Judges' Association [S1]
